subject: Will my Twitter secret key be visible on shinyapps.io?

messages.author: 136f92ffb7823092
messages.subject: Will my Twitter secret key be visible on shinyapps.io?
parts: My app includes searching for tweets on Twitter. If I upload the code to shinyapps.io, will the Twitter secret be accessible by anyone / can the public get to it?

messages.author: 6ca62a5f409b469f
messages.subject: Re: Will my Twitter secret key be visible on shinyapps.io?
parts:
Dirk,
If you're sending requests to the Twitter API in R code (as opposed to in the browser somehow, via Javascript), and haven't published in showcase mode [1], I think you can consider your secret private.

Alan

1. http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/display-modes.html
